note: Feature catalogue for the Ender 3 S1 configurator. Every define listed exists in configs/Ender3S1-F1-v2/ and is flipped by tools/configurator/apply_features.py. Costs are the price of having the feature ON; they are estimates until the first calibrated build says otherwise, and the UI shows predicted vs measured.

machines.label: Ender 3 S1 / S1 Pro board v2.4.S1.301 (STM32F103RCT6)
machines.bootloader_note: 28 KiB SD bootloader at 0x08000000; application at 0x08007000

machines.label: Ender 3 S1 with an STM32F401 board
machines.reason: F401 boards take a different image with a different vector offset and a 64 KiB bootloader on some variants. This builder only emits F103 images; flashing an F103 image onto an F401 board produces a silent board.

machines.label: Ender 3 V2 / other mriscoc printers
machines.reason: Different pin map, different display and different bed geometry. Not covered by this catalogue.

baseline.label: Ender3S1-F1-v2 (shipped build, 2026-07-30)
baseline.stamp_offset_note: the configurator stamps the image with Ender3S1-CFG, whose identity strings are 32 bytes shorter than the shipped Ender3S1-F1-v2 strings; measured by building the default selection

features.label: Input shaping on Z
features.summary: Third shaper axis. Compiled in the shipped build but switched off at runtime with M593 Z F0, so it currently costs flash and does nothing.

features.label: Smooth linear advance
features.summary: Ramps pressure instead of stepping it (M900 U). Removes classic linear advance's acceleration ceiling.

features.label: Non-linear extrusion (M592)
features.summary: Flow correction for back-pressure under-extrusion. Inert until A/B/C are calibrated with M592.

features.label: Skew correction (M852)
features.summary: Compensates a non-square frame. Identity factors until you measure them, so it changes nothing today.

features.label: Nozzle clean (G12)
features.summary: Automated nozzle wipe pattern. Only useful if your start G-code calls G12.

features.label: Fan kickstart (100 ms)
features.summary: Boosts the part fan briefly so it spins up reliably at low duty cycles.

features.label: Live Z from the host (M293/M294)
features.summary: Babystepping through the emergency parser, so OctoPrint can nudge Z mid-print.

features.label: Multiple probing per point (2 + 1 extra)
features.summary: Two fast probes and one slow re-probe, averaged. Turn this off and EXTRA_PROBING must stay 1 or the ProUI build sanity check aborts, so the two defines are always flipped together.

features.label: High-speed probe mode
features.summary: Faster probe deployment. Probing dominates bed-mesh time, so this is worth keeping unless it misbehaves.

features.label: MPC autotune menu
features.summary: Runs M306 autotune from the screen. Only needed while tuning the hotend model.

features.label: Cable flashing (binary file transfer)
features.summary: M28 B1 upload plus reboot-to-install, so firmware can go over USB instead of the SD card dance. Pulls in the heatshrink decoder. Dropping it is the single biggest saving available.

features.label: 5 G-code macros in EEPROM
features.summary: M810 to M819, persisted. Useful for per-filament settings sets (temperature, linear advance, input shaping).

features.label: Host status notifications
features.summary: Marlin pushes state changes to the host as action notifications.

features.label: Screen: custom colour themes
features.summary: Colour picker and its menu. Pure cosmetics.

features.label: Screen: live temperature plot
features.summary: Graph of temperature over time on the screen.

features.label: Screen: endstop diagnostics
features.summary: Endstop state page in the menu.

features.label: Screen: lock screen
features.summary: Scroll-to-unlock cover so a stray touch does not start a print.

features.label: Screen: G-code preview
features.summary: Parses thumbnails and preview data from the SD file. Heaviest of the screen extras.

features.label: Screen: toolbar
features.summary: Configurable toolbar on the status screen.

features.label: Print statistics (M78)
features.summary: Counts prints, finished jobs, total time and filament used.

features.label: Power-loss recovery
features.summary: Resumes an interrupted job. Needs the SD card left in the printer: the recovery file lives on it.

features.label: M503 settings dump
features.summary: The full settings echo. It is the only way to inspect everything at once, but it costs about 2.7 KB and it is also the command that watchdog-resets this build.

features.label: EEPROM chatter
features.summary: Echoes a confirmation for every settings command. It was trimmed out of the shipped build to buy flash for the feature set, so this is the catalogue's one add-back toggle.
features.measurement_note: enabling it against the default selection overflowed FLASH by 300 bytes with 1160 free, so the real cost is 1460 bytes, not the 130 first guessed

calibration.method: each feature toggled off alone against the shipped baseline, built and measured

observations.note: the two single-feature savings sum to 3732 B, the combined build saved 3724 B: an 8 byte interaction from section alignment. The predictor is therefore accurate to within the alignment granularity, not to the byte.
